basis: claim graph v0 (2026-10-21): rows carrying an entity in pots-findings v1.1 (148,186 rows) and eds-findings all tiers (22,961 rows); entity canonicalized with pipeline/crosstier_vocab.group_key (punctuation/case skeleton, case-protected gene symbols; kind evidence from both corpora); claim = (corpus, canonical entity, condition bucket, reference frame in {disease-state, intervention}, direction in {up, down, null}); support = distinct papers; contradiction = same corpus/entity/condition/reference with up and down asserted by disjoint paper sets
caveats: direction and reference are the extractor's fields; a contradiction is a candidate for human reading, not a verdict

canonicalization is a punctuation/case skeleton (43,736 -> 40,321 strings); synonyms such as 'HR'/'heart rate' or 'IL-6'/'interleukin-6' are NOT merged in v0, so support counts are lower bounds and some contradictions may be split across spellings
condition buckets are not crosswalked between corpora; cross-corpus tables are by entity
a 'contradiction' between papers can be a real disagreement in the literature, a population or assay difference, or an extraction error — the human read decides which
